dupphoto.mdd: Let me group the ones that look alike.
dupphoto.label.files: Several photos (they never leave your browser)
dupphoto.label.strict: How alike counts as one group
dupphoto.status.found: {groups} groups, {saved} freed if you delete the extras
dupphoto.note.noDelete: Nothing is deleted. a browser cannot delete files in your folders, and deleting cannot be undone. It only says which copy to keep and copies the list of names. Resized and re-compressed copies land in the same group, because it compares the picture, not the file bytes.
